text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Halfway through the training camp—Bamboo 
Memory threw herself into grueling 
training, pushing herself to the absolute 
limit.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Goal!! *pant* *pant*... *pant* *pant*... 
whew...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Training isn't over yet, right? I can 
still keep goin'!
choice_data_list: Let's rest up and prepare for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! In fact, to get ready for 
tomorrow, I'm gonna go do some strength 
training at the lodge!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much for your guidance 
today! Looking forward to tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is fired up to the absolute 
max, undoubtedly influenced by the 
Japanese Derby— and the fierce races of 
her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dedication was wonderful, but I 
worried about fatigue and injury from 
excessive training...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeesh, that's definitely overkill. How 
about it, wanna leave this to us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones calling out were Bamboo Memory's 
senior, the true-blue Edokko Inari One, 
and Tamamo Cross, who had made a name for 
herself in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Pushing her that far into a corner... I 
can't just keep my mouth shut.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! For the sake of our cute 
junior, let's roll up our sleeves and help 
out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Festival Training"!! What's that?! Never 
heard of it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, it's a Tracen Academy summer 
training camp tradition! Don't tell me you 
didn't know?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Usually it's the experienced ones who do 
the inviting, but I guess we're the first 
ones to ask her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not too late to start today! 
"Festival Training" is efficient, and 
it'll get you super shredded!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Super-duper hardcore?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's fun and puts very little strain 
on the body! It's a top-tier workout you 
can do without worry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! In other words, we won't have to make 
you worry either, Trainer-san?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wanna do the "Festival Training"!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty! So, where should we train next, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard of such training, but 
Inari One and the others must have 
something in mind. I'll just play along 
with them for now...!
choice_data_list: What do you say to the Power Up Course?
How about the Power Up Course?

Let's do *that* thing to build your 
tenacity!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Festival Training" will build some 
serious muscle! I wanna get started right 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're up for it! Alright, off to the 
training grounds we go~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! So this is the place...! Um, what 
should I do!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! See that pineapple over there? We're 
gonna harvest it—let the "Harvest 
Festival" begin!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Harvesting pineapples?! That's a pretty 
unusual training method!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That thing is crazy heavy! Half-baked 
strength won't even make it budge!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
An' then, we squeeze the juice from the 
harvested pineapples to make special 
shaved ice! You can't have a festival 
without shaved ice, right!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This is totally a "Harvest Festival"! I'm 
gonna catch 'em all, yes sir-ee!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uwooooh! Pineappllleee!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hnghhh! Huh!? This is insanely stiff, 
dude...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, there's a trick to it! Don't just 
use brute force, try twisting your body 
while pulling.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Um... twist it like this, and—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! It's coming off bit by bit! You're 
amazing, Inari-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Then, give it all ya got— grip 
it tight...! And wham... like that!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft, kuku...! What's that even about, 
haha! Please don't make me laugh!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Don't tense up too much, just 
keep pulling like that!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! Here we go! Reaaadyyy—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, that fruit juice syrup was delicious! 
I don't think I can ever go back to 
regular shaved ice!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, really hit the spot for your tired 
body, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Now this is the best part of the 'Harvest 
Festival'! How are ya feeling, Bamboo?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Getting a workout in AND eating delicious 
shaved ice? That's the best!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"That's splendid! Let's keep on having a 
blast together!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Inari-senpai, Tamamo-senpai! Trainer! 
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having thoroughly enjoyed the "Festival 
Training," Bamboo Memory seemed to finally 
relax her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What is that!? I'm crazy curious now!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know a way to make ya real persistent 
and tough! You're gonna love it~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The training is simple. We use this to 
take down "Kumajiro"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...A toy gun? Ah, shooting gallery!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The giant plushie "Kumajiro," 
which many champions have challenged every 
year only to be defeated! I'm gonna win 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
They're formidable rivals, ssus!! Whoaaa, 
I'm all fired up, ssus!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll show ya how it's done. Aim 
right for the vitals in one strike... Now 
that's style!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the base...! Kumajiro's 
shaking! Can't we just get it like this!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Stop...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~~! So close!! But there's still a 
chance—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you only get one shot. Knowing when 
to let go is true Edo spirit.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Inari-senpai...! That's way too cool!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No way, ya got ammo left, so it's a total 
waste not to shoot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't give a damn about pride! All I 
care about is snagging some souvenirs for 
the little ones!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oryaryaryaryaryarya!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Incredible rapid-fire! At this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I missed every single one?! My aim 
got totally thrown off by the momentum~~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Kumajiro... powerful enough 
to live up to the rumors. —But next time, 
Bamboo's gonna set off some real big 
fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right! Give 'em hell, Bamboo!! Don't 
let our race go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Both of you... gh! I'm gonna do it! I'll 
live up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There are two things I gotta do! Aim for 
the weak spot Inari-senpai pointed out, 
and strike all at once... just like 
Tamamo-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-It's wobblin' like crazy! You can do it! 
You've got this, Bamboo!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Goooooooo for it--!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, thanks a lot! Giving me that 
'Kumajiro' after you went through the 
trouble of winning it."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Please give them to your little brothers! 
I'm just satisfied that I was able to beat 
you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...It does feel lonely not being able to 
race anymore, though.
choice_data_list:
I'll just have to find a new formidable 
rival.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...! You got it! I'm totally down for a 
fun challenge like this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Let's all do this together again! 
'Festival Training' is the absolute 
best!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the help of her senpais, Bamboo 
Memory seemed to have thoroughly enjoyed 
forging her indomitable spirit.
